56: data class EnrollmentIconData(val color: Int, val imageResource: Int)
57: 
58: fun List<Program>.getEnrollmentIconsData(
59:     context: Context,
60:     currentProgram: String?
61: ): List<EnrollmentIconData> {
62:     val listSize = this.size
63:     var programCount = 0
64:     val iconDatas = mutableListOf<EnrollmentIconData>()
65: 
66:     val filteredPrograms = filter { it.uid() != currentProgram }
67:     for (program in filteredPrograms) {
68:         programCount++
69:         if (programCount >= 4 && listSize > 4) {
70:             break
71:         } else {
72:             val color = ColorUtils.getColorFrom(
73:                 program.style().color(),
74:                 ColorUtils.getPrimaryColor(
75:                     context,
76:                     ColorUtils.ColorType.PRIMARY
77:                 )
78:             )
79:             val imageResource =
80:                 ResourceManager(context)
81:                     .getObjectStyleDrawableResource(
82:                         program.style().icon(),
83:                         R.drawable.ic_default_icon
84:                     )
85:             iconDatas.add(EnrollmentIconData(color, imageResource))
86:         }
